protocol.settleRule: Minimum pause, autosave no longer saving, and two rAF callbacks before each action; actions/assertions outside the timed operation are excluded.
protocol.tabRule: Actual detail→palette and palette→detail, separate operations with explicit aria-pressed preconditions.
protocol.dragRule: First motion jumps12 CSSpx (above production3px threshold); primary event must move≥8px; live preview, committed pose, singleUndo, Redo and restoration checked.
protocol.colourRule: Actual quickColor control fill + Tab; input/change/blur recorded. Native colour-picker window latency excluded.
protocol.quantile: Nearest rank ceil(n*p). At20 samples P95 is second largest; fixed sample count and no removal of outliers.

measurement: Capture-phase performance.now() to next/second rAF callback execution; presentation opportunities, not actual pixel/photon paint. rAF callback intervals are not continuous rendered FPS. Playwright wall time is reported separately.

metricDefinitions.inputToNextRafMs: Capture-phase primary input to next rAF callback execution.
metricDefinitions.inputToSecondRafMs: Capture-phase primary input to second rAF callback execution.
metricDefinitions.commitToSecondRafMs: Colour: final change/blur to second rAF. Selection/tab: pointerup to second rAF. This is an event endpoint, not IndexedDB or semantic persistence completion.
metricDefinitions.actionWallMs: Measured action start to two final rAF callbacks; assertions and setup outside the timed operation are excluded.

harnesses.baselineCaptureSourceHash: Not recorded in the historical raw schema; no retroactive harness-source attestation is made.

sampleRetention.validation: Every operation, iteration, warmup flag and derived metric is revalidated from each hash-verified original raw capture.

retainedIntermediateStage.label: candidate6-core
retainedIntermediateStage.note: The candidate6 regression is retained even when a later final run improves; its original raw evidence is never overwritten.

limitations: One Windows device, sequential release batches, synthetic pressure fixtures. No population, scientific algorithm accuracy, worst-case or other-platform claim.
rAF callback execution is a presentation opportunity, not measured pixel/photon paint, continuous FPS or physical display latency.
All four operations and all four metrics are retained; this summary makes no blanket assertion that every latency improved.
Profile diagnostics and earlier v1/video protocols are separate evidence and are not pooled with these formal v2 captures.
